To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the circular duct is the most efficient shape in terms of pressure drop and the rectangular duct with aspect ratio of 2 is the least efficient shape.

the flow is steady at lower Reynolds numbers and it is unsteady at higher Reynolds numbers and the transition from steady to unsteadiness depends on the Reynolds number and the cross sectional shape of the duct.

the flow is steady in the range of Reynolds numbers from 1 to 1000 for circular and elliptical cross sections and for rectangular cross sections the flow is steady up to Reynolds number of 500 and for the Reynolds number of 1000 the flow becomes unsteady.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the fluid flow across a circular, elliptical and a rectangular duct.
the numerical study of external flow over ducts with different cross sectional shapes and different Reynolds numbers of the flow.
the flow of air over ducts of different cross sections and the effects of Reynolds number.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
for the same value of Reynolds number and velocity, a circular duct would have a higher pressure than a rectangular duct, an elliptical duct would have a lower pressure than a rectangular one.

the flow across the circular duct is steady and the flow is laminar for all the Reynolds numbers studied, the flow across elliptical and rectangular ducts is steady for low Reynolds numbers, and the flow across the rectangular duct is steady for higher Reynolds numbers, but for the elliptical duct the flow is unsteady for higher values of Reynolds number.
the flow is steady up to Re 100 and unsteady for Re >100 and the flow is steady for all Reynolds numbers for the rectangular duct.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the flow across the ducts with circular, elliptical and Rectangular cross section is steady for Reynolds number less than 1000.
the flow is more stable and steady for the elliptical cross section and the flow is less stable and more unstable for the rectangular cross section.
for the same Reynolds number the flow over elliptical duct is more stable and the flow is more turbulent over rectangular ducts and the flow over circular duct is the most turbulent.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the cross section shape plays a very important role in fluid dynamics and flow across a duct of a particular shape is not similar to flow across duct with different cross sectional shape.
the flow over the elliptical ducts is the smoothest and the flow over circular ducts is the most turbulent.
the flow is unsteady for the elliptical cross section for all Reynolds number values.
